verdict.rationale: Devin's API lets you programmatically create sessions (including on behalf of other users), and cloud sessions run in their own VM 'so it can keep going after you close your laptop,' with community reports confirming it can run for days on a single task. This supports launching multiple long-running autonomous sessions, but there's no explicit 'fleet' dashboard or multi-agent orchestration UI evidenced, and community reports note friction (no escape hatch, running in circles, needing manual termination) that complicates truly hands-off parallel operation. Missing for 10: dedicated fleet/multi-session management UI, evidence of simultaneously launching many parallel agents in one action, and independent confirmation that long unattended runs reliably produce useful results.
